about.description: A Textual User Interface for interacting with Atlassian Jira from your shell
about.head: 0f8b318

name: v1.16.0
body:
## What's Changed

### Added

* Add support for mentioning users when editing textarea-based fields by @whyisdifficult in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/364
* Add support for updating comments by @whyisdifficult in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/367
* Add support for `customfieldtypes:multiversion` by @cullenstone1 in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/366

### Bug Fixes

* Fix Jira Server sprint strings in work item details by @jesko2004 in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/361
* Fix bug in config screen by @whyisdifficult in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/369

### Minor Improvements

* Improve config screen by @whyisdifficult in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/365

## New Contributors
* @jesko2004 made their first contribution in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/361
* @cullenstone1 made their first contribution in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/366

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/compare/v1.15.0...v1.16.0
